notes.title: THE SPACE PUMPKINS ARE BACK! UNLOCK THE SPECIAL HALOWEEN ACHIEVEMENT!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11482664/cefa49a6e662612008ae1a2cfecc24b1d1deed2f.png[/img]

[h1]IT'S HALLOWEEN TIME,[/h1] The Space Pumpkins Invasion starts again for Halloween and you have the opportunity to unlock the special seasonal achievement.

[h1]YOU MUST STOP THE PUMPKIN INVASION![/h1]
The Space Pumpkins are here! They have appeared on many levels for players to find them. Now players will feel more compelled than ever not to only go for the straight path to the main victory, but to explore the space systems as true intergalactic explorers. 

[h1]AN ESPECIAL SEASONAL ACHIEVEMENT[/h1]
But all this is not only for the sake of great space exploration… you have the opportunity to unlock an special halloween achievement. This achievement can only be achieved by collecting ALL Space Pumpkins. So fuel your spaceship to the max and be ready to explore all corners of the galaxy. And be swift in doing so, because the achievement will be available for a limited period of time! 

[h1]EXPLORE A VAST GALAXY SYSTEM[/h1]
Six Sides of the World presents you a series of star systems to be explored. Each one is comprised by different puzzles that introduce new and more challenging mechanics. But most interesting feature of this is that these star systems can be navigated linearly, following a easier predetermined path; or you can make a detour if you are brave enough. Some of the puzzles will present more than one possible solution, enabling the player to achieve a more difficult victory, that will unlock new extra puzzles.

notes.title: Six Sides of the World 1.3 update
notes.content:
August and holidays are gone, it’s time to come back to work, [b]prototyping the next Cybernetik Design game[/b], but also it’s time to invest some efforts in Six Sides of the World because there are always errors hidden, unnoticed, and that’s the case.

Next you can find this little patch changelog:[list]
[*]Fixed some minor bugs in the interface.
[*]Added some missing translations.
[/list]

We found some glitches when the player clicked too fast on the menus causing a flickering effect on the interface. It’s not important, it does not causes any trouble to play the game, but once seen, can’t be unseen, and we’ve been looking for what causes it and it’s hopefully fixed.

Also, some parts of the translations of the game from the last narrative update were missing for some reason (surely a copy & paste issue, it’s the devil’s work, you always rely on it and you miss some sentence there and there). Now it’s fixed and all the texts of the game are complete.

On the other hand, we ran through some sales and bundles yet, and we’ve been watching your streams, reading your reviews and there’s a common point, the price. That’s because we are lowering it a little bit more. Have any friends who loves puzzle games and 5 bucks on your pocket? [b]Gift them Six sides of the World for $4.99[/b].

notes.title: ALL HAIL THE PUZZLE LORD!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that the [b]Word of the Puzzle Lord finally arrived to Six Sides of the World[/b].

Did you finish the game? You may want to play it again. This new version [b]adds a new narrative layer that will explain Maigo’s journey[/b].

Do you want more? There is more, harder and better. [b]5 new puzzles that will test your wit[/b].

Do you need something to gift your friend for his birthday? This is a perfect moment, [b]the game will be 50% off to celebrate this content update[/b].

[h1]Changelog 1.2[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 5 new puzzles.  You can find them on the “Extra puzzles” in the main menu. To unlock them you must complete the level 6.1.
[*]Do you want to know what is happening? The game now includes some pieces of information after completing some levels. Discover the story about Maigo and its travel.
[*]Cubic planets are not a natural phenomenon, someone created them. Explore the levels of the game to discover the seven hidden holograms that unveils the story of the creation of these unique and special planets.
[/list]

[/list]

Enjoy!!

notes.title: Update 1.1 Available
notes.content:
Hello!

We've updated the game to version 1.1 with these changes

[list]
[*]Added an option on the main menu to configure the puzzle speed to four different levels. This affects the total time of the timers and the speed of the rotating laser turrets, satellites and other space things
[/list]
